decisions.story_title: ShinyHunters Claims 284M Patient Records from McKesson Breach
decisions.reason: Major healthcare breach: ShinyHunters claims 284 million patient data records from McKesson, a top U.S. pharmaceutical distributor. McKesson disclosed the incident via SEC 8-K filing on Aug 28, discovered Aug 25. Significant scale and sensitive health data make this newsworthy. Separate incident from the Carhartt ransomware attack.

Vendor research blog post from Unit42/Palo Alto on LLM safety fragility. Generic AI safety thinking piece, not a real security event, vulnerability, or attack. Duplicates an existing story with same title.
Bruce Schneier's Friday Squid Blogging: fun filler post about a squid spill in Rhode Island. Not a security event.
